dedupe_keys.name: capmetrics archive of capital metro vehicle locations austin texas

description: CapMetrics is an archive of vehicle location data from Capital Metro, the transit agency of Austin, Texas. Its author continuously captured the instantaneous vehicle positions that Capital Metro published on the Texas open data portal, stored them in a database and published each day's data the next day as CSV files; routes and schedules are described by the agency's GTFS feed. Part of the data, from March to December 2015, was loaded into a public Google BigQuery table. The README asks users to credit the repository when publishing work with it. Coverage: Capital Metro buses and trains in Austin. Format and access: CSV files in a public repository. Licence and cost: MIT, free. Caveats: the project is no longer maintained and collection is suspended indefinitely, so the series stops. It supports capacity planning and service reliability studies such as headway and delay analysis. It relates to the Bus Observatory archive and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
